enrichr.note: Enrichment is queried live, but each library is requested BY EXACT NAME, so the live API returns the PINNED snapshot (GO_Biological_Process_2023, Reactome_Pathways_2024, WikiPathways_2019_Human, KEGG_2021_Human), not the newest version. Newer libraries exist (verified 2026-11-20 via Enrichr datasetStatistics): GO_Biological_Process_2026 (5,954 terms), WikiPathways_2024_Human (829), KEGG_2026 (352); Reactome_Pathways_2024 is the only Reactome version listed. Updating a library means changing its name in the engine and re-running the calibration (docs/validation/calibration-enrichr-route.md). Local GMT copies are bundled for the offline path; KEGG is fetched on demand by the updater, never bundled (see DATA_LICENSES.md).

mirbase.note: Installed 23.1 on 2026-11-18 via the updater (mature.fa 74,463 entries, hairpin.fa 46,603). Thesis validated names against v22; v23 (Aug 2026) added 8,847 hairpins and 27,005 mature products and renamed entries (e.g. hsa-miR-107 -> hsa-miR-107-3p).

mirtarbase.local: miRTarBase 9.0 official index (hsa_MTI.xlsx, 957,040 rows, 2,947 miRNAs, 396,758 pairs; built 2026-11-19)
mirtarbase.note: Validated targets served LOCALLY from the official miRTarBase 9.0 index (local_db/mirtarbase_official.json.gz, built by build_mirtarbase_official.py from the user's own download of hsa_MTI.xlsx). Levels: strong = Functional MTI (+30), weak = Functional MTI (Weak): CLIP-seq/microarray/proteomics (+15). Live Harmonizome API only a fallback. The old Harmonizome GMT snapshot (local_db/mirtarbase_gene_set_library.gmt.gz, 596 rows: 576 hsa-miRNAs + 20 rows from other species) is kept as a fallback when the official index is absent. Redistribution terms could not be verified: the official site returned 404 on every page when checked on 2026-11-19 (see DATA_LICENSES.md); the raw xlsx is never committed.

targetscan.note: Local database (targetscan_full.txt.zip, 8.3 MB). No v9.0 release found as of 2026-11-18.

kegg.note: Downloaded on demand by the updater; never bundled in the repo (Kanehisa Labs prohibits redistributing KEGG).
